entries.title: Supplier Invoice
entries.llmPrompt: Supplier-issued final invoice to the tenant for goods or services. Identify the actual line content, invoice number, delivery/service period and amount owed; industry alone does not determine the cost account.
entries.matchMode: Goods: PO - GRN - invoice; services: PO/contract + acceptance
entries.approvalMode: Budget owner + Finance, per approval matrix

postTo.ledger: Expense / prepayment / inventory / eligible asset or GRNI; AP; eligible input tax
postTo.subLedger: Accounts payable - supplier; cost centre/project

financeReview.remarks:
Book the economic cost in the correct period. Clear any existing accrual; do not post the same invoice twice.
Required evidence: Approved PO/contract or authorised non-PO purchase; service/delivery evidence.
financeReview.postingTrigger: Valid final invoice and evidence of the obligation; coding and approvals complete. Accrue received but unbilled services separately at period end.
financeReview.indicativeDebit: Underlying expense, prepayment, inventory or eligible asset; or GRNI/accrual if already recorded; eligible input tax
financeReview.indicativeCredit: Accounts payable - supplier (gross); clear prior accrual as appropriate
financeReview.taxTreatment: Validate the actual line tax code, jurisdiction and recoverability; separate eligible input tax only. Do not assume a GST rate or a credit for every purchase.
financeReview.referenceMapping: Adapted from document types / Document Type!C4:AL4 and document types / Document Type!C17:AL17; service profile added.
financeReview.configurationDecisionRequired: Map tenant accounts, tax codes, contract evidence, tolerances and approval limits. No automatic-payment authority is implied. Classify goods versus services before selecting the match profile and debit account.

entries.title: Expense Claim
entries.llmPrompt: Employee-submitted expense claim with business purpose and itemised receipts for costs personally paid. Distinguish supplier bills and corporate-card transactions.
entries.approvalMode: Manager + Finance, per approval matrix; no self-approval

postTo.ledger: Expense / eligible asset; employee payable or advance; input tax if recoverable
postTo.subLedger: Employee reimbursement / advance ledger; cost centre/project

extractionFields: each receipt supplier, number, date, category, net/tax/gross and currency

financeReview.remarks:
Debit the underlying expense or eligible asset. Clear a staff advance only where one actually exists; otherwise recognise the employee reimbursement payable. Check corporate-card duplicates.
Required evidence: Itemised receipts; business purpose; manager approval; advance reference only if applicable.
financeReview.postingTrigger: Approved business expenditure supported by receipts/policy evidence; employee and tax checks passed. Payment subsequently clears the payable.
financeReview.indicativeDebit: Expense or eligible asset; recoverable input tax if entitled
financeReview.indicativeCredit: Employee payable, or staff advance for the substantiated amount covered by that advance
financeReview.taxTreatment: Check each receipt and business use; claim GST only where reimbursement and tax-document rules permit. A claim form is not itself a supplier tax invoice.
financeReview.referenceMapping: Adapted from document types / Document Type!C15:AL15 and document types / Document Type!C16:AL16; expense/advance distinction corrected.
financeReview.configurationDecisionRequired: Confirm employee master, expense categories, budget limits, advance recovery and reimbursement tax rules; payment bank check uses employee master.

entries.title: Customer Invoice
entries.llmPrompt: Tenant-issued customer invoice to a customer for billed goods/services; establish issuer, recipient, final invoice and service/delivery period. Exclude pro forma documents.
entries.matchMode: Customer contract/SO + service or delivery evidence
entries.approvalMode: Finance; billing approval per delegated matrix

postTo.ledger: AR control; revenue / contract liability; output tax if applicable
postTo.subLedger: Accounts receivable - customer; contract/project

extractionFields: line quantity/rate, net, discounts, tax and gross

Record the receivable when the right to payment is unconditional. Recognise revenue when the relevant performance is delivered; assess advance billing separately.
Required evidence: Approved contract/SO or billing authorisation; delivery/service completion evidence.

financeReview.indicativeDebit: Accounts receivable - customer (gross)
financeReview.indicativeCredit: Revenue if earned; otherwise contract liability for advance billing; or contract asset already recognised; output tax as applicable
financeReview.taxTreatment: Determine tax from the supply, customer/location and registration rules; taxable, exempt and out-of-scope lines may differ. Do not infer tax from industry alone.
financeReview.referenceMapping: Adapted from document types / Document Type!C9:AL9; service matching and revenue timing added.
financeReview.configurationDecisionRequired: Confirm contractual billing rights, performance obligations, recognition schedule and customer tax status.

entries.title: Credit Note
entries.llmPrompt: A supplier or tenant credit document referring to an earlier invoice and an adjustment/return. Establish issuer and recipient to determine AP or AR direction.
entries.approvalMode: Finance; commercial owner where required

postTo.ledger: AP or AR control; original expense/inventory or revenue; tax adjustment
postTo.subLedger: Supplier AP or customer AR - resolve before posting

extractionFields: credited line quantities/rates, net, tax and gross

Supplier-issued credit reduces AP; tenant-issued customer credit reduces AR. Validate direction and original tax treatment. Returned stock/COGS may require a separate inventory transaction.

financeReview.indicativeCredit: AP credit: original cost/asset and input-tax reversal as applicable. AR credit: customer receivable.
financeReview.taxTreatment: Adjust tax using the original supply and applicable adjustment-note rules; never assume every commercial credit changes GST.
financeReview.referenceMapping: New profile using document types / Document Type!C4:AL4 and document types / Document Type!C9:AL9 for AP/AR direction; no direct reference row.
